messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'has half life': The subject drug remains in the body for the duration specified by the object entity.
C. 'has duration of treatment': The subject drug is typically taken for the length of time specified by the object entity.
D. 'has onset of effect': The subject drug starts to work or shows its effect within the time period specified by the object entity.
E. 'has maintenance phase start': The subject drug transitions to a maintenance dosing regimen starting on the day specified by the object entity.
